answers.q1: uv (lockfile uv.lock, build backend pdm-backend, Python 3.11 per .python-version). Install with: uv sync --group dev --extra all. CI test jobs use: uv sync --no-dev --group tests --extra all. The pre-commit job uses: uv sync --locked --extra all.
answers.q2: bash scripts/test.sh (this sets PYTHONPATH=./docs_src and runs pytest -n auto --dist loadgroup tests scripts/tests/). CI runs the coverage version, bash scripts/test-cov.sh, which needs 100% coverage.
answers.q4: CI lint runs through the pre-commit job: uv sync --locked --extra all && uv run prek run --from-ref origin/<base-branch> --to-ref HEAD --show-diff-on-failure. To run all hooks locally, use uv run prek run --all-files. The lint hooks inside it are: uv run ruff check --force-exclude --fix --exit-non-zero-on-fix, uv run ruff format --force-exclude --exit-non-zero-on-format, uv run mypy fastapi, and uv run ty check. The hooks also include typos and zizmor. For a check-only version without autofix, run bash scripts/lint.sh (mypy fastapi; ty check; ruff check fastapi tests docs_src scripts; ruff format fastapi tests --check).
